nextSteps: Create signing.env from SIGNING.example.env before running signed release commands.
Install a valid Developer ID Application certificate in Keychain.
Set real APPLE_ID, APPLE_APP_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD, and APPLE_TEAM_ID values.
Set real Windows signing certificate and password values.

decisionBoundary.blockerScope: External-only blockers stay in operator docs; repo-local hardening and regression work stay in the engineering queue.

externalOnlyBlockers.label: mac signing / notarization credentials
externalOnlyBlockers.unblockWhen: A real Developer ID certificate and Apple notarization credentials are available in signing.env or an explicit env override.

externalOnlyBlockers.label: Windows code-signing credentials
externalOnlyBlockers.unblockWhen: A real Windows code-signing certificate and password are available in signing.env or an explicit env override.

externalOnlyBlockers.label: Real iPhone Korean IME confirmation
externalOnlyBlockers.unblockWhen: The physical-device Korean IME checklist has been run once and recorded with a real iPhone result.

manualOperatorGates.label: Desktop signing credential gate
manualOperatorGates.whenToRun: Before attempting signed macOS or Windows release commands, or any time the question is whether signed release readiness changed.
manualOperatorGates.unblockWhen: A real signing.env or explicit env override exists and all Apple/Windows signing values are real rather than placeholders.
manualOperatorGates.keepOutOfEngineeringWhen: The only missing inputs are signing credentials, certificates, or signed artifact generation in the current workspace snapshot.

manualOperatorGates.label: Real-device Korean IME gate
manualOperatorGates.whenToRun: Before claiming final mobile confidence beyond simulator coverage.
manualOperatorGates.unblockWhen: The physical-device Korean IME checklist has been executed once and recorded with a real iPhone result.
manualOperatorGates.keepOutOfEngineeringWhen: Simulator validation is green and the remaining gap is only the physical-device confirmation pass.

manualOperatorGates.label: Object storage operator gate
manualOperatorGates.whenToRun: Before claiming attachment upload/download readiness in a target deployment.
manualOperatorGates.unblockWhen: Real storage env values are present, /api/health/ready still excludes storage by design, and the separate storage gate passes.
manualOperatorGates.keepOutOfEngineeringWhen: Baseline readiness is green and the remaining uncertainty is deploy-time S3/MinIO configuration rather than a reproduced repo defect.

manualOperatorGates.label: Voice / LiveKit operator gate
manualOperatorGates.whenToRun: Before claiming voice/video readiness in a target deployment.
manualOperatorGates.unblockWhen: Real LiveKit env values are present, /api/health/ready still excludes voice by design, and the separate voice gate passes.
manualOperatorGates.keepOutOfEngineeringWhen: Baseline readiness is green and the remaining uncertainty is LiveKit/operator setup rather than a reproduced repo defect.

triageSequence.label: Read deploy/runtime authority first
triageSequence.purpose: Start from the runtime and verification source of truth before classifying a blocker.

triageSequence.label: Refresh the current release snapshot
triageSequence.purpose: Regenerate the repo-local blocker snapshot so operators do not reason from stale dist state.

triageSequence.label: Recheck operator-doc alignment after snapshot/doc edits
triageSequence.purpose: Confirm the blocker summary, current status, final operator checklist, and snapshot still agree.

triageSequence.label: Use the smallest automation shortlist before widening scope
triageSequence.purpose: Pick the current smallest repo-local smoke command instead of reopening broad engineering work.

triageSequence.label: Separate code failures from operator/environment gaps
triageSequence.purpose: If repo-local verification passes, keep credentials, accounts, and device needs in operator docs.

notCodeBlockers: Missing signing.env in a fresh workspace
A dirty worktree that still contains active user-authored changes
Credential placeholders or missing certificates in the current operator environment
Real-device confirmation work that cannot be completed repo-locally
engineeringEscalationRules: Escalate to engineering only when a documented repo-local verification command fails unexpectedly.
Escalate to engineering only when release snapshots contradict the current source-of-truth docs.
Do not overwrite, revert, stash, or clean user-authored local changes just to manufacture a clean git state for handoff.
If the next action still requires credentials, account access, or a physical device, keep it in operator/blocker docs instead of reopening code work.
